name: Sanada Miwako
source:
A woman who works in the hospital administration office.
She has a rather straightforward personality and speaks her mind.
She cares about the protagonist after he was fired from his job in the administration office.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134732/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/miwako.html]official website, archived[/url]]
